evidence.dlls: Both wrappers contain identical x86 PE SHA256 e33747bc8c4c2a09846c4bd73fe9cd67eff2cef9a9be1a1f3fade6964d644b18. DllMain launches svchost with a duplicated token, writes image headers/sections and PEB ImageBase, sets (WOW64) thread context and resumes. RC4 KSA/PRGA decrypts config using a ten-byte stack key. Print-monitor installation is not established by these bytes.
evidence.stealer: At outer offset 0x12388 a repeating four-byte XOR reconstructs a managed PE. It defines ChromeGetLocalName, DecryptBlob, os_crypt/encrypted_key, wallet/Discord targets, ChannelFactory, PartsSender and FullInfoSender. A separately decoded native RunPE stub receives vbc.exe and the image buffer through an indirect dispatch.
